text: 中国经济信息社刊发的《中经社信号|“Token贷”兴起 银行竞逐算力金融赛道》报道称，近期，广东省首个词元经济专项金融产品“Token贷”在广州市海珠区落地，中国银行广州分行为相关企业授信约2800万元。此外，建设银行、农业银行、江苏银行、上海农商银行、张家港农商银行等也纷纷落地算力相关信贷产品，将算力算效、词元（Token）消耗等纳入授信评价。
text_en: A report published by China Economic Information Service, titled "Signal from China Economic News | 'Token loans' emerge as banks race in computing power finance," said that recently, Guangdong Province's first specialized financial product for the token economy, the "Token loan," was launched in Haizhu District, Guangzhou. Bank of China's Guangzhou Branch granted credit of about RMB 28 million to related enterprises. In addition, China Construction Bank, Agricultural Bank of China, Jiangsu Bank, Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank, and Zhangjiagang Rural Commercial Bank have also introduced computing power-related credit products, incorporating computing power, computing efficiency, and token consumption into credit assessments.
